info.title: Zakira.Replay
info.description: Let LLMs and AI agents "watch" video. Zakira.Replay turns any video source — YouTube URLs, conference recordings, course lectures, local files — into speaker-attributed transcripts (captions or local Whisper STT), frame-level OCR and structured vision (local or LLM-routed), slide-aware grouping, and timestamped JSON evidence that agents can reason over. Ships as both a CLI (`zakira-replay`) and an MCP server (`zakira-replay mcp serve`) in one .NET 10 binary.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show all in-flight progress messages and info-severity warnings. Default mode suppresses both and only surfaces the final summary plus warning/error severities; quiet mode suppresses everything except errors. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress all in-flight progress and all non-error output. Only error-severity warnings are emitted. Mutually exclusive with --verbose. [default: False]
